supersedes: g0-criteria.json (v1, preserved unchanged — never edited in place)
supersession_reason: v1 named an in-repo validation target that turned out to be the same series it was meant to check, and its enumeration of market-cap consumers was incomplete. Both are handler defects found by the worker. No pass threshold from v1 is weakened; one is added.
adjudicated_by: cc (Opus) — handler, on independent verification, not by accepting the worker's report

amendment_1_step_a_validation.finding: data/yf/finance/{SYM}.unadjusted.json history_unadjusted is SPLIT-ADJUSTED, not as-traded. It is bit-identical to data/edgar/r1-panel/prices/{SYM}.json closes.
amendment_1_step_a_validation.handler_independent_check: AAPL, 1323 overlapping dates, max relative difference 0.0. The repo fetcher documents the basis at scripts/fetch-yf-finance.py:954-957 and calls yfinance with auto_adjust=False, which suppresses dividend adjustment only.
amendment_1_step_a_validation.consequence: v1 Step A1 measured the split factor itself, not a reconstruction error. A1 is VOID as a validation. Its 39.0 pooled max relative error is not evidence against the reconstruction and must never be cited as such.
amendment_1_step_a_validation.handler_correction: The v1 claim that AAPL 49.48 x 4 = 197.92 matches the as-traded close rested on handler outside knowledge, not on repo evidence. It is downgraded to [not verified] and is not used as support anywhere.
amendment_1_step_a_validation.why_G0_survives_this: The direct route never required an as-traded data source. Both bases start from the same split-adjusted close, and their ratio reduces to a quotient of split-factor products. Split-map correctness, not as-traded availability, is the only external dependency.

replacement_validation.A2: r1-panel closes vs history_unadjusted, expect exact equality — confirms the basis claim
replacement_validation.A3: PRIMARY. Reconstruct the as-traded series independently from the r1-panel fetch and the r3-panel fetch and require identical values. Two independent Yahoo fetches agreeing on both closes and split factors is the strongest in-repo evidence available.
replacement_validation.A4: supporting only. At each split date the reconstructed series must drop by approximately the split ratio; the residual is that day's genuine price move, and spin-off-style ratios (IBM 1.046, MRK 1.048, MMM 1.196) are not expected to match tightly. No numeric threshold is attached, and A4 alone can neither pass nor fail Step A.
replacement_validation.A5: NEW. Cross-check the split maps against a third independent source already in the repo: data/yf/finance/{SYM}.json field splits. Require agreement on every event dated inside the panel window. Disagreement on any in-window event is a stop.
replacement_validation.pass_rule: A2 exact AND A3 exact AND A5 agreement on all in-window events. A1 is not scored.

amendment_2_market_cap_consumers.v1_claim: market cap enters exactly one place, size = log(mcap) in r3-incremental.mjs:64
corrected_enumeration: r3-robustness.mjs:29 — size control in the bounded-survivorship leg
r2-gls-icc.mjs:176-188 — cap-weighted index aggregates (mean, median, 5% trimmed) and cap_weighted_mean_icc_minus_rf
amendment_2_market_cap_consumers.why_it_matters: The third consumer is not a control variable, it is the index-level product candidate named in mandate section 13. A basis error there moves the aggregate weights directly. v1 had no pass condition covering it; C6 is added below.
amendment_2_market_cap_consumers.unchanged: No consumer feeds the GLS-ICC solve. Predictions P1-P4 stand.

amendment_3_worker_report_correction.worker_claim: Q4: data/yf/finance/{SYM}.json carries no splits field; repo split maps live only in r1-panel and r3-panel.
amendment_3_worker_report_correction.verdict: REFUTED by handler. The field is present: AAPL 5 events, NVDA 6, AMZN 4, each keyed by date with the ratio as value.
amendment_3_worker_report_correction.consequence: A third independent split source exists and is now required as A5. This also confirms that the R0-CORRECTED run, whose script reads exactly this field, was operating on real split data rather than silently applying a unit factor.
amendment_3_worker_report_correction.second_correction: The report names GOOGL@2023 as a P5 candidate while also establishing that GOOGL is absent from the 368 R2 symbols. Both cannot hold; GOOGL is excluded, so it cannot produce a candidate cell.

pass_conditions.note: C1 through C5 are carried over from v1 verbatim and unweakened. C6 is added.

C6_cap_weighted_index_aggregate.quantity: per-origin cap-weighted mean ICC, DIRECT vs CORRECTED
C6_cap_weighted_index_aggregate.rationale: Mandate section 13 names the cap-weighted mean as the primary index aggregation. It is the one quantity where a market-cap basis error reaches a product number directly rather than through a control variable. The 25 bp bound matches C2 so the firm level and the index level are held to the same tolerance.

verdict_mapping.G0_MATERIAL_BASIS_DEPENDENCE: any one fails; public numeric release of the ICC lens is refused regardless of later gates

data_contract_stop.condition: DIRECT computable for fewer than 95% of the cells CORRECTED covers
data_contract_stop.action: report to owner; do not substitute inputs; do not relax the definition

prohibitions_carried_forward: no post-result change to any threshold, band, set, or basis rule
no feedback of a price-implied ICC into a same-date fair-value discount rate
no network acquisition to satisfy a coverage gap
